name: Artificial Intelligence, Ph.D. / Integrated MA-PhD
department: College of Informatics — Department of Artificial Intelligence

deadline.value: Exact Fall 2027 international admission dates have not yet been published; Korea University Graduate School's Admission Procedure states that Fall semester applications and required documents are submitted in March (Spring 2027 online applications ran September 1-10, 2026; Fall 2027 semester begins September 1, 2027).
deadline.quote: STEP1 | Submission of application form & required documents | September (Spring semester) | March (Fall semester)

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology; no GRE Subject Test exists for this discipline.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Korea University Graduate School's Eligibility page and 2027 International Application Guide do not state a pre-application supervisor requirement for this department.

funding.value: International applicants are evaluated automatically and simultaneously for Korea University Graduate School Scholarships for International Students: Global Leader Scholarship (Type A: 100% entrance and tuition fee waiver + KRW 500,000/month living support for 4 months per semester; requires CGPA >= 3.57/4.0 or 4.0/4.5 and TOEFL iBT 90 / IELTS 7.0) and Natural Science and Engineering Scholarship (Type C: 65% tuition fee waiver; requires CGPA >= 3.14/4.0 or 3.5/4.5 and TOEFL iBT 82 / IELTS 6.0). Scholarships cover the first semester and are renewed competitively by GPA each semester; GKS and BK21 assistantships are also available.
funding.quote: Korea University Graduate School Scholarship for International Students | Both admission evaluation and scholarship award evaluation will be conducted automatically and simultaneously. | Foreign Student Scholarship A | 100% of entrance fee and tuition fee | Living support fee (Only 4 months during semester) | Foreign Student Scholarship C | 65% of tuition fee | Living support fee (KRW500,000 per month)

entry_route.value: Korea University Graduate School offers both the Doctoral (Ph.D.) program (for Master's degree holders) and the Integrated Master's-Doctoral (Integrated MA-PhD) program (for Bachelor's degree holders) in this department.
entry_route.quote: The applicant must have completed regular primary, secondary and higher education, equivalent to Grades 1 to 12 and Bachelor (or Master or Ph.D) in the Korean education system in overseas.

also.quote: Integrated MA-PhD | Doctoral | Time Limits for Course of Study

notes: Offers Ph.D. and Integrated MA-PhD in Artificial Intelligence within the College of Informatics (Seoul Campus). Statistical Data Science and Intelligent Statistical Learning Ph.D./Integrated MA-PhD tracks are also offered in the Department of Statistics, and Big Data Science is offered at Sejong Campus.
